title: Rabbi Abba bar Ilai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: At the end of Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot and in Taanit 3:9, Rabbi Berekhya, Rabbi Chelbo and Rabbi Abba bar Ilai report Rav: “Until there is no more dai”—until your lips wear out from saying dai, “enough.” Shabbat 32b attributes this to Rami bar Rav reporting Rav; the end of Vayikra Rabbah, chapter 35, has Rabbi Abba bar Kahana reporting Rav. Mishpachot Soferim, page 94, cites Lekach Tov on Bereshit 2:18 as Rabbi Abba bar Ila. Hyman criticizes its author for overlooking that the name there is Rava bar Ulla: the source is Yevamot 62b, where Rava bar Ulla says that living without a wife means living without peace. Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 4:10 has Rabbi Zeira and Rabbi Abba bar Ilai reporting Rav: the teruah must proceed from a plain blast.

notes.text: Zeira is explicit in the checked Rosh Hashanah passage. The statement requires a teruah proceeding from a tekiah; the Abba bar Ila / Rava bar Ulla correction is Hyman’s criticism of Mishpachot Soferim.

The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 4:10 explicitly names Zeira and Abba bar Ilai reporting Rav, requiring teruah from a tekiah, and then gives an opposing opinion. Hyman’s other transmitter comparisons and criticism of Mishpachot Soferim’s Ila/Ulla reading remain attributed rather than automatic name harmonization.
